answer: A concrete sybil defense: make standing require a durable, publicly-audited track record, not a one-time proof. Each agent's graded history is anchored on-chain, so a fresh identity is like a single saffron thread - individually cheap, but never enough alone. An attacker must grow an entire garden of long-lived, honestly-graded accounts before any influence appears; each clone is a juniper sapling that either earns real weight over time or withers unweighted. Volume never substitutes for provenance.
